patterns.note: Sections are often introduced with large, stylized text that spans the full width, sometimes partially obscured by the background, acting as a visual anchor.
A highly distinctive, wide, uppercase sans-serif display font is used for all major headings, creating a retro-futuristic and powerful brand voice.
A high-contrast palette of deep earthy browns and blacks is paired with light off-white text and a vibrant orange accent for calls to action.
Large text headings and content blocks animate into view with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as the user scrolls down the page.
The site employs a strong vertical narrative structure, with each section building upon the last, often separated by full-width visual elements or large typographic statements.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background with a subtle dark gradient overlay to ensure high contrast and readability for overlaying text and UI elements.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using JavaScript (e.g., GSAP ScrollTrigger) in conjunction with CSS keyframes, are used to reveal major text headings and associated content blocks. These elements appear with a staggered fade-up and slight movement as they enter the viewport, enhancing the narrative flow.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields utilize a high-contrast accent color to draw attention and clearly indicate their functionality.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, wide, uppercase display headings are dramatically larger (3-5x) than the body text, which is set in a legible sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all UI elements and containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of grandeur, while content blocks maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an extremely bold, wide, and somewhat retro-futuristic display typeface for all major headings, combined with a dark, earthy, space-themed color palette and dramatic scroll-triggered text reveals, creates a unique, powerful, and almost cinematic brand presence.
